data.long_description:
This modern studio in Val by KASCO presents an exceptional investment opportunity in one of Dubai’s fastest-growing waterfront districts. With efficient design, premium finishes, and unbeatable connectivity, this unit is perfectly positioned for strong rental returns and long-term capital growth.

Property Features:

Smart, efficient studio layout ideal for both short-term and long-term rental strategies
Contemporary interiors with high-quality finishes
1 Bathroom | 450.46 Sqft
Floor-to-ceiling windows enhancing natural light
High-demand unit type ensuring strong occupancy rates

Location Benefits:

Prime Al Jaddaf Waterfront location
Minutes to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Festival City, DXB Airport, and major business hubs
Close to hotels, healthcare facilities, transport links, and waterfront leisure attractions
High tenant demand due to excellent connectivity and vibrant surroundings

Community & Amenities:

Resort-style facilities: swimming pool, modern gym, wellness zones, landscaped social decks
Retail, dining, and recreational options within and around the community

Investment Appeal:

Flexible payment plan with attractive entry point
Strong short-term rental potential
Upcoming handover ensures future capital appreciation
Low maintenance and high-demand apartment type

Perfect for investors seeking a turnkey, high-yield, growth-ready opportunity in a strategic Dubai location.
